definitions.explanation: Without leaving any area unchecked or untouched. Describes searching, looking, or covering an area completely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧くまなく⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I searched every corner of the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧くまなく⟦{捜索|そうさく}→捜索：19220_sousaku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The police are searching the mountain thoroughly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧すみずみ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧くまなく⟦{届|とど}いていた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: The sunlight reached every corner of the room.

notes:
Written as {隈|くま}なく. The kanji {隈|くま} means "dark corner" or "nook," so the word literally means "without dark corners" — i.e., leaving no corner unchecked.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- くまなく⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to search every corner
- くまなく⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to examine thoroughly
- くまなく⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look all over
- くまなく⟦{捜索|そうさく}→捜索：19220_sousaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to search exhaustively

USAGE: Often used with verbs of searching, inspecting, or covering an area. A somewhat literary word, more common in writing and formal speech than casual conversation.
